venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 10/29 (MOD JK/MKZ; entered by Daniel; posted 12:51am 10/30).** Net $1,895 vs $1,737 target (+9%). Food $339. Comps $21. 65 guests, $29.15 avg. Slow steady start, nice rush around 7pm; many zombie and El Diablo cocktails sold for Halloween activations. NC vs Green Bay on TV and Thursday specials sold. Late industry push ~10:30; out by 12:30. 86: Noilly Prat vermouth, small white trash bags. Favorite moment: meeting Michael, a Death & Co investor, who loved the cocktails and atmosphere.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Very nice out, drove foot traffic
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 10/29 (MOD KK/KE/MD & JMS; entered by JO; posted 3:21am 10/30).** Net $1,548 vs $2,782 target (-44%). Food $51. Comps $29.50 (1.9%) — industry, F&F, resident. ~58 guests, $26.70 avg. Steady-paced night; ~$500 by 7pm, pickup ~8pm. Few watched TNF. Dates, friends, small bachelorette, industry from Noko and Lakeside Lounge. Thursday usually busier. Kitchen: lower food sales.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 10/29 (AM Chef Josh & Maggie S; PM Chef Lucas & Evan F; entered by Evan; posted 2:00am 10/30).** Net incl. events $7,630.19 vs $10,224 target (-25%). DC/AM $901.76, D&C PM $6,728.43. Food $1,695.40. No events. Comps $164.17 (~2.15%). 191 guests (Tock). AM: fresh mocha, coffee delivery received. PM: brutally slow start, picked up shortly after; made it through unscathed. Kitchen: chill Thursday, new kitchen hire Sam; prepping for event.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 10/29 (MOD/Chef Kyler & Steves; entered by stef; posted 2:10am 10/30).** Net $6,444 vs $5,736 target (+12%). Food $629, beverage $5,815. Comps $230.33 (3.6%) — industry and friends. 206 guests (SevenRooms), $31 avg. Booming Thursday for Halloweekend; near-full room at open, little waitlist. Two end-of-night reservations merged into one growing large party, accommodated. Lots of costumes and industry visitors. Menu count 17/17. Breakage: 1 nick and nora. No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 10/29 (MOD Gigi/Joe & Josh; entered by Gigi; posted 5:55am 10/30).** Net $6,384 vs $5,764 target (+11%). Food $1,362. Standing Room $1,309 (food $216); Marquee $5,075 (food $1,146). Comps $238.50 — DNLs, gifts, regulars, birthday. 162 guests, $85.55 avg (as reported). Consistent steady pace; Standing Room opened at 7pm for first night of Dia de Muertos activation with poet Yvonne, great decor feedback. Streets very empty; no rush. Special cocktail menu popular. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 10/29 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; posted 2:33am 10/30).** Net incl. events $5,730.28 vs $4,456 target (+29%). Marquee bar sales $6,308.13 (gross). Food $1,172.20. Comps $122.82. 130 guests (80 walk-in / 50 reso), $44.08 avg net/guest (reported GCA $43.03). Busy from the jump; full by 6:30, packed by 7, helped by next-door gallery event listing the address. Many 3-5 tops. Ran short-staffed (no barback, solo floor) and crushed it; kitchen strained on dish. Improvement: current braille menu. Maintenance: curtain.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 10/29 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Marcus; entered by Alexis; posted 2:09am 10/30).** Net $12,002 vs $8,625 target (+39%). Municipal Bar AM $2,360 / PM $7,356; Sun Club $145; Hot Eye $1,965. Food $4,320. Comps $170. 168 guests (OpenTable 22 AM + 146 PM), $71.44 avg. Slow day AM; good but hectic Thursday night, closed without an SA. Sun Club hit by wind/clouds. Hot Eye slow start, packed from 11:45 after film let out, many costumes. Kitchen steady, no 86s.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Thursday 10/29 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Curtis Hayes; posted 4:00am 10/30).** Net $9,620 vs $11,015 target (-13%). Food $1,605. Comps $280.17 (2.7%) — 3 employee discounts, 3 DNLs. 216 guests (89 resos), $45.59 avg. Great Thursday despite rain; strong room energy, minimal waitlist, early cuts. Potential buyout and member lead. Kitchen $1.6k, oysters strong. Favorite moment: friend Jeff Lawrence to start building a playlist.
